subject: Post-call: token economics & org alignment
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@wavefront.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: token economics & org alignment

Hi Elena — great to chat earlier. Quick recap and the asks we surfaced so we can keep momentum: 

1) Expected monthly volume (tokens): ~20M - 50M tokens/month (starter burst in Q2 ramping to steady state).
2) Target unit economics: looking to land baseline pricing in the range of $900 - $1,400 per 1M tokens depending on latency tier and KV caching. At 50M tokens/mo the blended target we discussed was roughly $1,050/1M tokens.
3) Commitment ask: you mentioned a 6–9 month pilot with potential to convert to a committed pool if performance and latency targets are met.

Action items we agreed:
- You: confirm the economic buyer and procurement contact (name + email) so we can route contract and finance questions.
- Jordan (me): share an updated pricing matrix and a short mutually agreed MA(Plan) / next-steps timeline. Attached initial pricing matrix and a draft SOW for scope.
- Wavefront: aim to have internal finance look at target $/1M tokens and confirm whether the pilot budget fits the range above or if we should reprioritize model/latency choices.

Notes on price sensitivity: If Wavefront can commit to a 12M token minimum over 6 months, we can tighten to the lower end (~$900/1M) provided KV caching is enabled and burst capacity stays under 200 RPS. Otherwise, the mid-tier $1,200–$1,400 range is more realistic for guaranteed low latency.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-matrix-v2.pdf (pricing bands and examples), SOW-draft.docx (pilot scope).

Proposed next meeting: 30 Mar, 10:00–10:30 PT to align on who signs off on budget and procurement path. Please confirm attendees.

Thanks — Jordan

Samir / Procurement — looping you in with the pricing matrix and draft SOW (attached). Key points for finance review: 

- Pilot budget range (as stated by Wavefront): $40k–$80k over 6 months.
- Baseline pricing options included in the matrix:
  * Option A (Lower-latency, reserved): $1,400 / 1M tokens (no KV caching assumed)
  * Option B (Balanced): $1,050 / 1M tokens with prefix/KV caching and 30% batching efficiencies
  * Option C (Commit-tier): $900 / 1M tokens with 12M token commitment over 6 months + 10% prepay

Questions for finance: which option maps to existing internal procurement thresholds? If Wavefront can sign up for Option C commit, we can price-lock for the pilot and include rollback clauses tied to latency SLOs. If not, Option B is the conservative starting point.

Marissa / Vivek (internal) — can you confirm whether we have authority to offer a one-time promotional credit for the pilot (up to 20% off first 3 months) to help close? If yes, I'll include the suggested credit in the meeting deck.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-matrix-v2.pdf, SOW-draft.docx

Thanks,
Jordan

Jordan — thanks for the clear summary and for looping finance. Quick internal answers: 

- We can approve a one-time promotional credit of up to 15% off invoice for the first two months of a pilot under $75k total ARR equivalent. That authority is available for AE-managed pilots; anything above that needs CRO sign-off.
- Vivek: please confirm whether the discount should be applied as an invoice credit or a prepaid credit on the account. Also confirm if we want a standard clause limiting credits to one-time per customer.

External: Samir/Procurement — Jordan included three pricing options above. If you can indicate which option is acceptable from a finance perspective, we will prepare the legal/contract redline and an initial invoice schedule.

- Jordan to set 30 Mar 10:00 PT meeting invite with Samir + procurement + Elena + Marissa + Vivek.
